        var players = [];
        var sliderEl = document.querySelector('.f36-section-7 [uk-slider]');
        var playTimer = null;
        var PLAY_DELAY = 500; // 👈 停留 500ms 后再播放

        if (!sliderEl) return;

        window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady = function () {
            var iframes = sliderEl.querySelectorAll('iframe');

            iframes.forEach(function (iframe, index) {
            players[index] = new YT.Player(iframe, {
                events: {
                onReady: function (event) {
                    event.target.mute(); // 默认静音
                }
                }
            });
            });

            bindSliderEvents();
        };

        function bindSliderEvents() {
            // 切换开始：立刻暂停所有视频
            UIkit.util.on(sliderEl, 'itemhide', function () {
            clearTimeout(playTimer);
            pauseAll();
            });

            // 切换完成：延迟播放当前居中
            UIkit.util.on(sliderEl, 'itemshown', function () {
            clearTimeout(playTimer);
            playTimer = setTimeout(playActive, PLAY_DELAY);
            });

            // 页面首次进入
            playTimer = setTimeout(playActive, PLAY_DELAY);
        }

        function playActive() {
            var items = sliderEl.querySelectorAll('.uk-slider-items > li');

            items.forEach(function (item, index) {
            var player = players[index];
            if (!player || !player.playVideo) return;

            if (item.classList.contains('uk-active')) {
                player.playVideo(); // 静音播放
            }
            });
        }

        function pauseAll() {
            players.forEach(function (player) {
            if (player && player.pauseVideo) {
                player.pauseVideo();
            }
            });
        }
        })();
        </script>

        <script>
            document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

            const BATTERY_CAPACITY = 3840;
            const EFFICIENCY = 0.85;
            const EXTRA_LOAD = 30;
            const THRESHOLD = 500;
            const MAX_POWER = 3600;

            const input = document.querySelector('.input-power');
            const button = document.querySelector('.btn-enter');
            const resultBox = document.querySelector('.uk-heading-large');

            let currentValue = 0;

            // ====== 数字动画 ======
            function animateNumber(target) {
                const duration = 600;
                const start = currentValue;
                const startTime = performance.now();

                function update(now) {
                    const progress = Math.min((now - startTime) / duration, 1);
                    const ease = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);

                    const value = start + (target - start) * ease;

                    resultBox.innerHTML =
                        value.toFixed(1) +
                        '<span style="font-size:40px;">Hrs</span>';

                    if (progress < 1) {
                        requestAnimationFrame(update);
                    } else {
                        currentValue = target;
                    }
                }

                requestAnimationFrame(update);
            }

            // ====== 限制最大输入 ======
            function limitMaxValue() {
                let value = input.value.replace(/[^\d]/g, '');

                if (value === '') {
                    input.value = '';
                    return;
                }

                let num = parseInt(value, 10);

                if (num > MAX_POWER) {
                    num = MAX_POWER;
                }

                input.value = num;
            }

            function calculateRuntime() {
                let watt = parseFloat(input.value);

                if (isNaN(watt) || watt <= 0) {
                    animateNumber(0);
                    return;
                }

                if (watt < THRESHOLD) {
                    watt += EXTRA_LOAD;
                }

                const runtime = (BATTERY_CAPACITY * EFFICIENCY) / watt;
                animateNumber(runtime);
            }

            function updateButtonStyle() {
                const watt = parseFloat(input.value);

                if (!isNaN(watt) && watt > 0) {
                    button.classList.remove('uk-button-default');
                    button.classList.add('uk-button-primary');
                } else {
                    button.classList.remove('uk-button-primary');
                    button.classList.add('uk-button-default');
                }
            }

            // 输入时限制最大值 + 更新按钮
            input.addEventListener('input', function () {
                limitMaxValue();
                updateButtonStyle();
            });

            // 回车计算
            input.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                    calculateRuntime();
                }
            });

            // 点击按钮计算
            button.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                calculateRuntime();
            });

        });
        </script>

            <a id="b_accor_item_Ry7ED9" class="t4s-accor-title" href="#t4s-accor_item_Ry7ED9" rel="nofollow" data-t4s-tab-item="" data-no-instant="">

                <span class="t4s-accor-icon"></span>
                <span itemprop="name">How many expansion batteries can I connect with the FB3840?</span>

              </div>
            </div>
          </div><div class="t4s-tab-wrapper " data-t4s-tab-wrapper="" itemscope="" itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question">

                <span class="t4s-accor-icon"></span>
                <span itemprop="name">Does F3600 Pro support App control?</span>

                <span class="t4s-accor-icon"></span>

              <div itemprop="text">
